configuration_bisect.method: remove one line at a time; user and network namespace with only lo; -i lo -D wext; still running after 2 s counts as accepted

correction: auth-trial-hardware.json first said the trial found no process identity at its immediate /proc start-time check. The tl log shows that check passed and the exit was detected at the first liveness poll; the record now says so.
emulation_limits: qemu-user does not support NETLINK_GENERIC sockets and returns ENOSYS for wireless-extension ioctls, so driver initialization, scanning, association and the 4-way handshake cannot be exercised offline.
Offline acceptance of the configuration does not prove hardware Wi-Fi authentication.

fix.collect: a connected wext attempt counts as authentication evidence; collect reports each attempt and its exit status
fix.configuration: update_config removed; only ap_scan and one RSN/WPA2-PSK/CCMP network block (ssid, scan_ssid, psk, proto, key_mgmt, pairwise, group, ieee80211w).
trial_script: -D nl80211 first, at most 90 one-second polls for CTRL-EVENT-CONNECTED
one -D wext attempt of at most 60 polls, only after the nl80211 process is confirmed gone (it exited, or SIGTERM then SIGKILL after the wait); two supplicants never run at once
a process that cannot be confirmed gone blocks the wext attempt and fails the gate
each attempt records auth/auth_wext and its exit status auth_rc/auth_wext_rc in tl (255 initialization failure, 126/127 exec failure, 128+N signal N)
unchanged: trial writes limited to tl and senv

hardware_log.source: flash TL mailbox, read after stock return

limitations: No raw logs, configuration, credentials, network identifiers, private hashes or run identifiers are included.

offline_reproduction.configuration: the private wpa.conf of the third trial payload; never printed or committed
offline_reproduction.executable: the pinned trial runtime of the third trial payload (static ARMv5 EABI5 soft-float wpa_supplicant 2.11)

probable_cause.confidence: probable; the hardware exit status was not captured
probable_cause.mechanism: auth/wpa.config sets CONFIG_NO_CONFIG_WRITE=y. wpa_supplicant 2.11 compiles the update_config global field only without CONFIG_NO_CONFIG_WRITE, so update_config=0 is an unknown global field: the configuration fails to parse and wpa_supplicant exits with status 255 before opening any socket or driver interface.
probable_cause.why_nothing_was_logged: CONFIG_NO_STDOUT_DEBUG removes the parse-error message, and the event-only patch prints only the five fixed events.

real runtime under qemu-arm keeps running on the generated configuration
real runtime under qemu-arm still exits 255 once update_config=0 is added
stock-BusyBox trial chain: nl80211 exits 255 then wext connects, and nl80211 times out then wext connects; exit statuses and backends are checked
collect accepts a connected wext attempt and rejects a lost one
